        if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$referencedSha)) {
            $result.status = 'REWORK_REQUIRED'
            $result.safe_to_execute = $false
            $result.blocking_findings = @($result.blocking_findings) + [pscustomobject]@{
                severity = 'HIGH'
                finding = 'The implementation report has no verifiable non-null applied commit.'
                evidence = 'No appliedCommit/headCommit SHA could be extracted from the triggering comment.'
                required_action = 'Post a new CLAUDE_APPLIED comment only after the implementation is committed and pushed, with the exact SHA.'
            }
        } elseif ($null -eq $githubEvidence.commit) {
            $result.status = 'REWORK_REQUIRED'
            $result.safe_to_execute = $false
            $result.blocking_findings = @($result.blocking_findings) + [pscustomobject]@{
                severity = 'HIGH'
                finding = 'The claimed applied commit could not be verified through GitHub.'
                evidence = "GitHub commit evidence for $referencedSha was unavailable or failed to load."
                required_action = 'Push the exact implementation commit to the repository and post a corrected CLAUDE_APPLIED report anchored to that SHA.'
            }
        }
    }

    if ($result.human_required -and $result.status -notin @('HUMAN_GATE', 'NOT_APPROVED')) {
        $result.status = 'HUMAN_GATE'
        $result.safe_to_execute = $false
    }

    if ($result.status -eq 'IGNORE') {
        Write-Log "Codex classified the event as IGNORE; no GitHub response posted."
        exit 0
    }

    $responseMarker = if ($eventKind -eq 'CLAUDE_APPLIED') { 'CHATGPT_VERIFIED' } else { 'CHATGPT_DECISION' }
    $summary = ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $result.summary
    $decision = ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $result.decision
    $reasoning = Format-Bullets -Items @($result.reasoning)
    $evidence = Format-Bullets -Items @($result.evidence_checked)
    $blocking = Format-BlockingFindings -Items @($result.blocking_findings)
    $nonblocking = Format-Bullets -Items @($result.nonblocking_findings)
    $actions = Format-Bullets -Items @($result.required_actions)
    $limitations = Format-Bullets -Items @($result.limitations)
    $appliedCommit = if ($null -eq $result.applied_commit) { 'None' } else { ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $result.applied_commit }

    $commentBody = @"
[$responseMarker][$eventId]
Status: $($result.status)
Reviewer: Codex $($route.Model) / $($result.risk_class) (event-driven, read-only)
Trigger comment: $eventCommentId
Applied commit: $appliedCommit

## Summary
$summary

## Decision
$decision

## Reasoning
$reasoning

## Evidence checked
$evidence

## Blocking findings
$blocking

## Non-blocking findings
$nonblocking

## Required actions
$actions

## Execution boundary
- Safe to execute: $($result.safe_to_execute)
- Human required: $($result.human_required)

## Limitations
$limitations

$dedupeTag
"@

    if ($commentBody.Length -gt 60000) {
        throw "Rendered review comment exceeds the safe GitHub comment length."
    }

    $post = Post-IssueComment -Repository $repository -IssueNumber $issueNumber -Body $commentBody -Headers $headers
    Write-Log "Posted review comment $($post.id) for $eventKind/$eventId."

} catch {
    $message = $_.Exception.Message
    Write-Error $message

    if ($null -ne $headers -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($repository) -and $issueNumber -gt 0 -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($eventCommentId)) {
        try {
            $safeMessage = ConvertTo-SafeMarkdownText $message
            $safeEventId = if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($eventId)) { 'UNKNOWN' } else { $eventId }
            $errorTag = "<!-- ai-review-error-event:$repository:$eventCommentId -->"
            $errorBody = @"
[CHATGPT_REVIEW_ERROR][$safeEventId]
Status: NOT_APPROVED

The event-driven reviewer failed closed. No approval or product decision was inferred.

- Trigger comment: $eventCommentId
- Error: $safeMessage
- Required action: restore the self-hosted runner/Codex authentication or review tooling, then re-run this workflow for the same event.

$errorTag
"@
            Post-IssueComment -Repository $repository -IssueNumber $issueNumber -Body $errorBody -Headers $headers | Out-Null
        } catch {
            Write-Error "Failed to post the review error to GitHub: $($_.Exception.Message)"
        }
    }

    exit 1
} finally {
    if ($reviewWorktreeAdded -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$repoRoot) -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$reviewRoot)) {
        try { & git -C $repoRoot worktree remove --force $reviewRoot 2>$null | Out-Null } catch { }
    } elseif (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace([string]$inputDir) -and (Test-Path -LiteralPath $inputDir)) {
        try { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $inputDir -Recurse -Force } catch { }
    }

    if ($null -ne $mutex) {
        try { $mutex.ReleaseMutex() } catch { }
        $mutex.Dispose()
    }
}
